mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To simplify the process of buying, selling, and renting properties in Algeria through transparency, technology, and trust.

values.heading: Built on three pillars
values.subheading: Every decision we make comes back to the three principles that define who we are and how we serve Algerians.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Honest pricing, verified listings, and no hidden fees. What you see is exactly what you get.

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: Powerful search, smart filters, and an intuitive experience built for how Algerians actually look for homes.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: Every listing is reviewed. Every agent is vetted. Your safety and confidence come first, always.

quote.text: We believe everyone in Algeria deserves a place they can truly call home — and we're here to make that journey easier.

team.title: Meet our team
team.description: We're a dynamic group of individuals passionate about reshaping how Algerians discover, buy, and rent property.

cta.title: Find your next home today
cta.description: Join thousands of Algerians who've already found their perfect property with Menzeli.
